reason: 'Leaves ... basal 3–15(–25) cm': leaf length 3–15 cm with a 25 cm extreme. The context slot 'basal' (FLOPO_0991002) is filled.
Styles 3, with 5 as the extreme. The count is right.
'leaves numerous': leaves present, count word 'many'.

fix: 'anther thecae X' must map to PO_0009069 anther theca, not fall back to the anther. 'Thecae confluent' means the two thecae run into each other. It does not mean the anthers are joined to each other.
reason: Confluent is said of the thecae within one anther. 'Anther connate' would wrongly say the anthers are fused together.

fix: '<part> ..., margin X' should narrow the bearer to the margin when PO has a margin class (petal margin PO_0025008).
reason: Subundulate is said of the petal margin. Undulate with 'approximately' is otherwise right.
'Leaves crisped when dry, erect-spreading when moist': erect-spreading reads as semi erect, and the condition 'moistened' is filled.
These are true alternatives for the leaf blade shape. 'Beltlike' (strap-like) is fairly read as lathlike PATO_0002467, and 'linear' is PATO_0001199.
'Acorns solitary or paired': the fruit arrangement is solitary or paired, and these are real alternatives.
'1 per node': leaf count 1, position per stem node.

fix: 'inner/outer <part> N cm' must fill the position slot. Inner and outer bracts of a Protea involucre differ greatly in size.
reason: The outer bracts described just before are smaller. 'Bract length 2.5–4.5 cm' holds only for the inner bracts. The numbers themselves are right.
Peduncle longer than the leaves: increased length compared with the leaf.

fix: 'lateral sepals X' / 'dorsal sepal Y' in orchids: fill the position slot. Otherwise a quality of the lateral sepals is given to all sepals.
reason: Only the lateral sepals are adnate to the column foot. The dorsal sepal is described separately and is free.

fix: Outside Asteraceae and similar groups, 'head' means a dense inflorescence, not PO_0030121 capitulum inflorescence. The synonym 'head' → capitulum should apply only to taxa with true capitula.
reason: The bracts are much shorter than the head, so 'decreased length' is right. But a Carex head is a cluster of spikes, not a capitulum.
'Sepals ... abaxially puberulent': sepal abaxial epidermis puberulous.

fix: In Fabaceae, 'standard' is a synonym of PO_0025324 banner petal. It must map there, not to the general petal, because wings and keel have other colours.
reason: The colour is said of the standard only. The wings and keel are described separately, so 'petal yellow' is too broad. Golden-yellow read as approximately yellow is fine.

fix: 'blade ..., apex obtuse or acute': narrow the bearer to the apex (bearer_scope), as for other 'apex X' clauses.
reason: Obtuse or acute describes the blade tip. The blade as a whole is ovate or oblong.

fix: 'le réseau (de nervilles) peu marqué' after the secondary veins means the network of finer veins. The bearer is the tertiary/higher-order leaf veins, not the leaf.
reason: The whole leaf is not inconspicuous. Only the vein network is faint, in contrast to the fairly clear secondary veins.
The pericarp becomes dark brown when dry: colour dark brown, condition 'dried'.
The leaflets are appressed-pubescent at least on the lower side. The bearer 'abaxial epidermis' with pubescent is right, and the 'or sometimes glabrous' alternative is a separate annotation.
'Root cylindric, to 2 cm in diam.': root diameter up to 2 cm.
'cymes ... densely few-flowered': flowers present, few, inside the inflorescence.
'Seeds numerous': seeds present, many.

fix: 'secondary veins N' must map to PO_0020140 secondary leaf vein, not to the general vascular bundle PO_0005020 that 'vein' falls back to.
reason: The count of about 12 on each side of the midvein is right, but it counts secondary leaf veins in particular.
'Racèmes axillaires ou terminaux': the inflorescence position is axillary or terminal, and these are real alternatives.
'feuilles raméales nombreuses': many leaves are present. Leaving out 'on the branches' does not make it false.
Styles about equal to the stylopodium: length with a ratio of 1.
'Petals ... abaxially glabrous': petal abaxial epidermis glabrous.
'leaflets ... abaxially glabrous': the abaxial epidermis of the leaflets is glabrous.
'Sepals 8 in 2 whorls': sepal count 8.
'Fruits ... indehiscent': fruit dehiscent, negated.
